entities.summary: Korinna Schumann is an Austrian Social Democratic politician and union leader who has served as Minister of Labour, Social Affairs, Health, Care and Consumer Protection in the Stocker government since 2025. She previously served a term as President of the Federal Council from 1 July to 31 December 2022. Since 2018, she has been the Women's Chair and of Vice President the Austrian Trade Union Federation (ÖGB), as well as a member of the Federal Council.
